name: zopt_toggle_hud_type_for_current_hw_mode
description: zOpt::ToggleHudTypeForCurrentHwMode toggles the active HUD type option between standard and perspective, and leaves any other active value unchanged.
known_limits: Binary Ninja disassembly for 0x413600 calls zOpt::GetHudTypeForCurrentHwMode, toggles value 1 to zOpt::SetHudTypeForCurrentHwMode(2), toggles value 2 to zOpt::SetHudTypeForCurrentHwMode(1), and otherwise tail-calls zOpt::GetHudTypeForCurrentHwMode again.
tier S verification remains deferred to the HUD option/callback cluster because this wrapper is functionally complete but not yet covered by a VC object-byte pass.
